title: Lobe
summary: LOBE, noun [Latin lobus; Gr.] 1. A part or division of the lungs, liver, etc. 2. The lower soft part of the ear. 3. A division of a simple leaf. 4. The cotyledon or placenta of a seed. LO'BED, adjecti
